thread:
Oliver Grant: quick sync  i'm proposing a docs change to clarify our pricing tier boundaries and update the dashboard examples + a new Go SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/821 (internal)

Maya Patel: sounds useful. where are the confusing bits right now?

Oliver Grant: two spots: the tier table shows inclusive/exclusive bounds unclearly, and the dashboard panels use 'capacity' vs 'committed' inconsistent labels. customers hit support about which units push them into next tier.

Iris Novak: can you paste the updated tier table copy you want? small wording change should fix most confusion.

Oliver Grant: plan is to change label to "Committed units (monthly)" and add a short line: "Tiers are determined by billed committed units; transient burst usage does not change tier assignment." also added explicit boundary examples: "S: 06k, M: 36k180k, L: 180k+"

Ben Park: we'll need to make sure billing export and the tier mapping table UID match the docs permalink. dropped the Grafana UID I want updated in the PR description so panels don't break: grafana uid = 4b7a2c9d.

Maya Patel: can you include a PromQL snippet that uses the committed_units label so users can build the same panels?

Oliver Grant: added this sample in the PR:

```
sum by (tenant) (increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total{usage_type="generated"}[30d])) / avg_over_time(tenant_committed_units[30d])
```

Iris Novak: minor nit  use rate() for realtime 1h view in some panels. maybe include both variants.

Ben Park: okay i'll update the saved panels. also add an annotation to the chart for "tier boundaries" so support can triage.

Maya Patel: we need SDK snippets for Go and curl in the migration guide. can someone paste a small Go example?

Oliver Grant: added this quick Go example to the PR:

```
// go metering example
package main

import (
  "bytes"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)

func main() {
  json := []byte(`{"tenant_id":"acme","metered_units":2048}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metering/report", bytes.NewBuffer(json))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
}
```

Oliver Grant: and a curl example next to it for quickcopy:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/metering/report \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","metered_units":2048}'
```

Iris Novak: nice. add a short note that `metered_units` maps to billing tiers on ingest and can't be changed retroactively (docs must call this out).

Ben Park: alerting question  what thresholds do we want in the docs panels so customers have a recommended starting point?

Oliver Grant: recommending warning at 75% and critical at 95% of committed units. for burst-enabled accounts add a sentence: "increase warning threshold to 85% to reduce noisy alerts". included alert snippet in PR:

```
ALERT TierUsageWarning
IF avg_over_time((sum by(tenant)(increase(redwood_metered_tokens_total[1h])) / tenant_committed_units) * 100[10m]) > 75
FOR 15m
LABELS {severity="warning"}
ANNOTATIONS {summary="Tenant {{ $labels.tenant }} approaching committed capacity"}
```

Maya Patel: preview when CI is done? i'll skim copy + SDK style. also please ensure the Go example conforms to our style guide (tiny import grouping).

preview-bot: CI passed  preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/changes/821 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

Iris Novak: pulled preview  two micro-nits flagged in PR comments: table alignment and a missing alt-text on the tier chart image.

Ben Park: i'll push a small panel caption tweak and add the annotation.

Oliver Grant: thanks all  aiming to merge after two approvals. will note in PR description to notify billing and support channels 7 days before we change any saved permalinks. merging in 10m if green.
